LanguageData.DMS_Gecko_FlameTurret.label: flamethrower
LanguageData.DMS_Gecko_FlameTurret.description: A flame projector used by mechs. It effectively ignites anything flammable within its range.
LanguageData.DMS_Iguana_SubMachineGun.label: mounted light machine gun
LanguageData.DMS_Iguana_SubMachineGun.description: A suppressive weapon chambered in full-power rifle rounds.\n\nThis weapon is designed specifically for mounted use, so only specific units can equip it.
LanguageData.DMS_Tarbosaurus_ShotgunGun.label: close-in defense system
LanguageData.DMS_Tarbosaurus_ShotgunGun.description: A multi-barrel shotgun turret for suppressing enemy infantry at close quarters. It reacts quickly at short range and fires three shells in succession.
LanguageData.DMS_Tarbosaurus_SubMachineGun.label: mounted heavy machine gun
LanguageData.DMS_Tarbosaurus_SubMachineGun.descriptio: A heavy machine gun for mech soldiers or infantry support platforms.\n\nThis weapon is designed specifically for mounted use, so only specific units can equip it.
LanguageData.DMS_SubTurret_127Gatling.label: mounted GAU-19/A
LanguageData.DMS_SubTurret_127Gatling.description: A multi-barrel machine gun turret mounted on the shoulder.
